desc: 墨蓝暗调画刊里的中古风电脑桌，背屏双抽把台面还给电脑
leaf: 中古风蜂蜜色木面电脑书桌（桌面后缘一道低背屏，屏内左右各嵌一只带小圆木钮的抽屉、中间为开放槽；四支外撇圆收分腿 + 窄望板；固定桌体，非升降学习桌、非转角桌、非桌椅套装）
name: 中古风圆腿背屏双抽电脑桌款

shots.intent: 首屏一秒交代桌面后缘那道低背屏嵌两只抽屉加中间开放槽这条清空台面的主线，用暗调画刊墙把蜂蜜色桌形顶出来，让买家在白色信息流里停住。
shots.textZone: left index rail numeral 01 over a full-width hairline rail carrying one brick-clay #C6553B block 「{callout_1}」, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 stacked over 「{selling_point_2}」 in #D9E2E6, two open corner-bracket glyph labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 用坐姿平视而不是俯拍，把电脑和杯子被杂物挤在台面中间、背屏空着没用的日常状态推到眼前，逼出下一屏的机制。
shots.textZone: one full-width hairline rail near the top with a brick-clay #C6553B block 「{callout_1}」 at its left end, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 below it, one open corner-bracket glyph on the rail

shots.intent: 正交侧剖一条线讲清背屏挡边、屏内开放槽与抽屉、窄望板与外撇圆腿的关系，是全页机制解释的核心一图。
shots.textZone: upper-right column: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16202B, then a horizontal numbered index rail along the bottom carrying four small corner-bracket numerals with 1px hairline risers up to 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 同一高角度同光双栏，把摊满台面与物件收进背屏抽屉和开放槽之后的净空台面并排，让人自己看出差别而不写一句功效话术。
shots.textZone: two brick-clay #C6553B label blocks, 「{callout_1}」 riding the left panel rail and 「{callout_2}」 the right, one centre seam headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16202B, numeral 03 on the index rail

shots.intent: 正面略偏的机位把桌子和椅子放回一间真实的暗调书房角，交代占地与氛围，让首屏的口号落到能用的一天里。
shots.textZone: upper band: numeral 04 on the index rail, one brick-clay #C6553B block 「{callout_1}」, headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 at 30pt over one small geometric sans sub line 「{callout_2}」 at 14pt

shots.intent: 正俯视把台面净空区、背屏两抽与中间开放槽的左右节奏一次摊平，用一张分区图替买家想清楚东西放哪。
shots.textZone: lower index rail: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #16202B at 28pt plus three small corner-bracket numerals with hairline risers to 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 掠射微距把小圆木钮、抽屉缝隙、开放槽边与台面封边做实，用可见做工替代一切等级与环保话术。
shots.textZone: two labels only: 「{callout_1}」 on a cold white #D9E2E6 card with a 1px hairline riser to the knob, 「{callout_2}」 to the rim banding, index numeral 06 on the left rail

shots.intent: 贴地仰视把圆腿的收分与外撇、腿与窄望板的交接、脚底接触阴影一次看清，用可见结构替掉稳固与承重主张。
shots.textZone: upper-right band: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 at 24pt over two short corner-bracket labels 「{callout_1}」 to the joint and 「{callout_2}」 to the leg foot, index numeral 07 on the left rail

shots.intent: 用一名匿名裁切的成年人坐在真实椅子上、膝部与视线与桌子和背屏对齐，让尺度可信，替掉任何尺寸数字与人体工学话术。
shots.textZone: left rail numeral 08 over a full-width hairline rail: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 at 30pt, one brick-clay #C6553B block 「{callout_1}」, two corner-bracket labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 pointing at the knee line and the band line

shots.intent: 把源页那一串重复图标卡改成三张同角度同曝光的竖卡，让买家一步看完真正存在的配置差异并选定。
shots.textZone: index numeral 09 on the left rail, one section headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 at 30pt on the top hairline rail, then one brick-clay #C6553B label block beneath each card reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 以夜里一盏台灯下的背屏台面收口全页，配一块只有占位行的参数卡与一条行动指令，把源页那张空白参数表变成不虚构的落点。
shots.textZone: upper right: a square-edged cold white #D9E2E6 parameter card with four placeholder rows 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」, closing headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #D9E2E6 and one brick-clay #C6553B action chip 「{callout_5}」, index numeral 10 on the left rail
